1u125m4:268: The success or failure of agent-as-retriever hinges entirely on tool design. Anthropic's context engineering principle has only one core criterion: if a human engineer can't clearly state which tool should be used for a given scenario, don't expect the agent to do better. So tools must be self-contained, error-resistant, extremely clear in purpose, and each one should do exactly one thing. Model Context Protocol (MCP) turns this pattern from a Claude Code feature into an ecosystem default—every data source (filesystem, database, observability, ticketing, SaaS) becomes a unified set of tools and resources the agent can call; once retrieval is a tool call, every data source becomes a candidate retriever, no manual vector index construction required.
